# Test cases for urljoin_ based on RFC 3986 reference resolution

# 1. Empty string returns base without fragment
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path#frag", "") == "http://base.com/path", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path#frag", ""), "http://base.com/path")

# 2. Absolute URLs replace the base
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "https://other.com/new") == "https://other.com/new", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "https://other.com/new"), "https://other.com/new")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "ftp://files.com/data") == "ftp://files.com/data", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "ftp://files.com/data"), "ftp://files.com/data")

# 3. Scheme-relative URLs (//host/p)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "//other.com/new") == "http://other.com/new", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "//other.com/new"), "http://other.com/new")
assert urljoin_("https://base.com/path", "//sub.domain/page") == "https://sub.domain/page", (urljoin_("https://base.com/path", "//sub.domain/page"), "https://sub.domain/page")

# 4. Absolute paths (/p)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "/absolute/path") == "http://base.com/absolute/path", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "/absolute/path"), "http://base.com/absolute/path")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "/root") == "http://base.com/root", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "/root"), "http://base.com/root")

# 5. Relative paths
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "subpage") == "http://base.com/path/subpage", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "subpage"), "http://base.com/path/subpage")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "subpage") == "http://base.com/subpage", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "subpage"), "http://base.com/subpage")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "../other") == "http://base.com/other", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "../other"), "http://base.com/other")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "../other") == "http://base.com/other", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "../other"), "http://base.com/other")

# 6. Dot (.) and Double Dot (..) normalization
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/c", "...") == "http://base.com/a", (urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/c", "..."), "http://base.com/a")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/c", "./d") == "http://base.com/a/b/c/d", (urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/c", "./d"), "http://base.com/a/b/c/d")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/c", "../../../d") == "http://base.com/d", (urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/c", "../../../d"), "http://base.com/d")

# 7. Query-only references (?q)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "?query=1") == "http://base.com/path?query=1", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "?query=1"), "http://base.com/path?query=1")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "?query=1") == "http://base.com/path/?query=1", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "?query=1"), "http://base.com/path/?query=1")

# 8. Fragment-only references (#f)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "#frag") == "http://base.com/path#frag", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "#frag"), "http://base.com/path#frag")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "#frag") == "http://base.com/path/#frag", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "#frag"), "http://base.com/path/#frag")

# 9. Complex combinations
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/", "../c?q=1#f") == "http://base.com/a/c?q=1#f", (urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b/", "../c?q=1#f"), "http://base.com/a/c?q=1#f")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b", "c/d") == "http://base.com/a/c/d", (urljoin_("http://base.com/a/b", "c/d"), "http://base.com/a/c/d")
